role: Conference speaker/room scalar records and known-code submission state
known_patches: Integer identity schemas and malformed description-as-type schemas repaired without argument-name changes
room_create uses the actual event slug to resolve Event.id
speaker list preserves event scope and adds real search filter
room_update event is a path selector, not a writable Room.event FK. Scope row_key by Event.slug resolved to Event.id, preserving the original event/pk arguments and update fields.
limitations: All 88 source tools remain; only nine declared write tools are effect-tested.
Source Team permission guards generally check any team globally, without a user-membership/event join; submission_accept lacks full authentication/organiser checks. No complete ACL claim.
speakerprofile_create inserts scalar profile but omits generated code/user linkage. Toggle-arrived sets true only; room_toggle_hidden only accepts a currently unhidden room.
Submission/Room read/list tools are absent. Writes require known codes/IDs; SpeakerProfile.internal_notes is the available readable carrier.
submissioncomment_create requires both a global team flag and administrator=true, so the original non-administrator persona cannot use it. No alternate tool or elevated persona is invented.
Room availability, scheduling constraints, invitation delivery, complete submission lifecycle and binary resources are not certified.
